title: What India's Factory Report (Manufacturing PMI) Tells Us About Our Economy
description: India's factory activity, measured by the Manufacturing PMI, expanded in October 2026, though at a slightly slower pace than September. The Purchasing Manager.

faq.q: What is the difference between Manufacturing PMI and Services PMI?
faq.a: Manufacturing PMI tracks the factory sector (making physical goods), while Services PMI tracks the service sector (like IT, finance, hospitality). Both are important for understanding the overall economy.

faq.q: Who releases the India Manufacturing PMI?
faq.a: In India, the Manufacturing PMI is compiled by S&P Global and sponsored by HSBC.

faq.q: How often is the PMI released?
faq.a: The Manufacturing PMI data is released monthly, typically at the beginning of the month, covering the activity of the previous month.

faq.q: Does the PMI include government-owned factories?
faq.a: No, the HSBC India Manufacturing PMI specifically focuses on the private manufacturing sector.

faq.q: What does "expansionary territory" mean for PMI?
faq.a: It means the PMI reading is above 50, indicating that the sector is growing or expanding its activity.
